data.narrative:
Reveal Technology is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Garrett Smith that has raised $30M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 11 same-sector and stage-adjacent comparables, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Castelion.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $30M raised proxy, implying a $60M valuation. Peer-median benchmarking across the 11-company Defense & Security comparables yields $1.0B, with the peer set ranging from $125M to $3.0B. The sample includes five Series B peers: Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

These methods support a triangulated valuation range of $51M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $530M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Reveal's relative competitive position within the Defense & Security frontier-tech landscape and the early-stage nature of Series A funding. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor, while peer-median anchoring reflects heterogeneity in scaling outcomes across the comp set. Further clarity on revenue traction, customer concentration, and defensibility would narrow this range materially.
